message:
This is a fix for a chrono formatting issue found by fuzzing. But this is from Nov 2022, and the OSS-Fuzz issue 42508631 is from around 2023. Let me check if this is the right fix. Let me look at the `write_fractional_seconds` function in the current code.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fmt && grep -n "write_fractional_seconds" include/fmt/chrono.h && sed -n '1030,1100p' include/fmt/chrono.h</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fmt && grep -n "write_fractional_seconds" include/fmt/chrono.h</parameter>
